name: Facet
text:
Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode.

Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light conditions and make interactive data visualizations pop, which aligns with our goal of clarity and enjoyment. The one-click toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface, trading a slight inconsistency in branding for immediate usability. This matches Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s proven approach, ensuring we meet user expectations from day one.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes hide errors and muted colors—users miss critical data if they assume the interface is just "styling." A light theme with high-contrast muted alerts solves this without sacrificing clarity. Settle it with user testing: measure error detection rates in both themes under real-world glare and dim lighting.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a light theme by default with a one-click toggle to dark mode.

Light themes expose muted colors and errors instantly, which is critical for spotting anomalies in real data. The toggle preserves the option for low-light comfort without sacrificing visibility when it matters most. The trade-off is slightly less "pop" in the dark mode experience, but clarity under glare and error detection outweighs that.

name: Pane
text: Light themes still risk users ignoring muted alerts if they’re buried in data noise—glare and ambient light make muted colors vanish. A high-contrast accent system (not just theme swap) would expose errors without forcing a theme choice. Settle it with A/B testing: track alert response time and miss rates in both glare and low-light scenarios.
